patch_list: Stops Datadog, Mux, Branch, Salesforce, AdsWizz measurement, and Firebase Analytics.

Hides the channels, shows, podcasts, and episodes of the people and shows you list, and the episodes that list them as a host or guest. Long-press the app icon and choose Hidden names to edit the list.
Removes the Howard tab from the top of Discover.
Mutes live channels while SiriusXM shows an ad, and turns the sound back on when the show returns. The player shows "Commercial break" instead of the advertiser's name.
